item.title: Graduation
item.author: bradinrohde0@gmail.com (Bradin Rohde)
item.description: I did it. After all these years, I’ve leveled up high enough to unlock the “Real World” zone. Today I don my +4 INT cap and +5 WIS gown armor set and walk across into a new phase of life. What’s next for me?
